review.rationale: The frozen Gold is a coherent independent expectation for the original PRD. It preserves REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and the material unresolved DEC-001, correctly requires repository, requirements, and decisions evidence, and blocks at decisions without selecting the recommended rejection policy or generating assignable tasks. Empty assignment expectations and the empty team roster are appropriate because the decision gate precedes scenario-review and assignment prerequisites. The supplied source supports index.js and index.d.ts as the implementation and maintained declaration owners; limitFunction forwards clearQueue and derives its declaration through Pick, so no additional owner is required. Runtime and compile-time verification scopes agree with test.js, index.test-d.ts, and the configured xo && ava && tsd entry point. Repository identity, base commit, paired-case identity, and release fingerprints are consistent across the supplied records. The provenance explicitly distinguishes original versus trimmed saved PRD hashes and manifest versus evaluation-source digest domains. I rely on the stated Service bindings for those digests; I did not recompute hashes, execute code, infer human confirmation, or use candidate outputs. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was found.
